notes: This timeline keeps the paper/research lineage separate from the later field-operation v20+ lineage.

entries.title: Initial YOLO + polygon occupancy MVP
entries.goal: Detect vehicles and decide whether three manually defined parking slots are occupied.
changes: Stabilization was required because the source was a phone recording of a CCTV monitor
results: Working MVP; no reliable quantitative benchmark recorded.
issues: Shaky re-recorded CCTV caused coordinate drift
Low-quality detections
Initial full occupancy made slot definition difficult
Single-point bbox judgment was fragile
entries.decision: Superseded by v2.

entries.title: Stabilized decision-zone occupancy
entries.goal: Reduce slot-boundary mistakes and make setup practical on low-quality footage.
results: Functional v2 artifact was produced; no frozen DEV/TEST benchmark recorded.
issues: Distant/black vehicles still weak
Accuracy-speed tradeoff remained
entries.decision: Moved to stronger detection in v3.

entries.title: High-resolution / tiled detection + UNKNOWN
entries.goal: Recover missed distant vehicles, especially the left-side black vehicle.
results: Detection recall improved in difficult regions, but tiled inference was very slow.
issues: Tile inference ran YOLO multiple times per frame
Fast 640/no-tile mode missed vehicles and was rejected
entries.decision: Keep detection quality and optimize execution frequency in the v4 direction.

entries.title: Detection-interval optimization direction
entries.goal: Keep high-resolution detection quality while reducing runtime.
changes: Reuse previous detections between YOLO runs
results: No frozen quantitative result was found in the retained research record.
issues: This version is recorded mainly as a proposed optimization step.
entries.decision: Research later shifted toward explicit slot/temporal state modeling.

entries.title: Point-based slots + linked duplicates
entries.goal: Make slot setup less dependent on visible parking-line polygons and support multiple CCTV views of the same physical slot.
changes: DEV state-condition search followed by TEST verification
results: No preserved frozen metric was found for v5.
issues: Geometry and perspective handling still needed improvement.
entries.decision: Perspective-normalized setup introduced in v6.

entries.title: 4-point perspective-corrected CCTV
entries.goal: Normalize tilted CCTV views before slot setup and detection.
changes: Slot setup and YOLO operate on warped CCTV
results: Perspective crop visually verified; no frozen quantitative metric recorded.
issues: Counting errors were still concentrated around slot identity and temporal transitions.
entries.decision: Established the geometry base used by later versions.

entries.title: Pre-anchor baseline
entries.goal: Establish a measurable DEV/TEST baseline before learned slot anchors.
changes: Error review focused on duplicate assignment and missed departures
issues: Errors concentrated in transitions
Duplicate slot assignment
Missed departures
entries.decision: Attempt learned anchor matching in v8.

entries.title: Hungarian 1:1 + learned anchors
entries.goal: Improve per-slot identity assignment using learned anchor centers and one-to-one matching.
issues: Anchor collapse / identity drift
Weak detections amplified matching errors
entries.decision: Rejected. Return authority to manual slot points in v9.

entries.title: Manual-point Voronoi + constrained anchor
entries.goal: Prevent learned geometry from overriding manual slot identity.
issues: Ghost occupancy and temporal persistence remained
entries.decision: Add causal temporal state tracking in v10.

entries.title: Causal temporal parking-state tracker
entries.goal: Distinguish maneuvering vehicles from stable parked vehicles without future frames.
issues: Detector mode and recovery strategy still needed comparison
entries.decision: Compare FULL/CROP/HYBRID evidence in v11.

entries.title: FULL vs CROP vs HYBRID
entries.goal: Determine whether slot crops outperform the full-CCTV detector.
issues: CROP/HYBRID were much less stable than FULL
entries.decision: FULL adopted; crop relegated to auxiliary recovery.

entries.title: FULL-protected auxiliary recovery
entries.goal: Use crop evidence only when it cannot erase a valid FULL detection.
changes: Protection against AUX deleting FULL evidence
results: HYBRID candidate generalized poorly and was not adopted
issues: Runtime remained high
Low-confidence repeated false positives remained
entries.decision: Selective AUX + cache optimization in v13.

entries.title: Selective AUX + cache safe baseline
entries.goal: Keep v12 accuracy while reducing runtime and max error.
issues: Remaining errors were mainly transition timing
entries.decision: Became the SAFE_BASELINE carried forward.

entries.title: ZONE_MEMORY experiment
entries.goal: Use recent slot memory to stabilize missed detections.
issues: Some slots became stuck EMPTY for long periods
Memory was too authoritative
entries.decision: Rejected; temporal memory should assist transitions, not replace state evidence.

entries.title: Transition-only temporal guard
entries.goal: Keep v13 SAFE_BASELINE and use memory only around actual state changes.
changes: Departure requires FULL miss + AUX miss + visual change
Weak YOLO cannot initialize OCCUPIED by itself
Manual point remains immutable unless dragged
results: Baseline protection retained; no superior frozen candidate adopted.
issues: Transition rules still needed more targeted evidence
entries.decision: Test segmentation and degradation robustness without changing baseline authority.

entries.title: SEG_ASSIST first pass
entries.goal: Use segmentation only as additional evidence on difficult frames.
issues: High compute cost with no useful state change
entries.decision: Do not use eager segmentation; make it lazy and condition-specific.

entries.title: RAW / enhanced degradation experiments
entries.goal: Test whether preprocessing can recover low-resolution, glare, and monitor-stripe cases.
issues: Generic enhancement was not condition-aware enough
entries.decision: Move to condition-specific adaptive preprocessing in v15.3.

entries.title: Condition-specific adaptive robustness
entries.goal: Use different recovery logic for LOW_RES, SUN_GLARE and MONITOR_STRIPES while preserving SAFE_BASELINE.
changes: Causal 5-frame temporal median for monitor stripes
Four timing fields: Total Elapsed / Step Elapsed / Step ETA / Total Remaining
results: Temporal median reduced stripe energy and improved retention in the recorded stress test
issues: Robustness GT initially had no useful balanced labels
Condition classifier/forced-slot issues remained
entries.decision: Improve classifier, cache migration and lazy scheduling in v15.4.

entries.title: Relative degradation classifier + lazy SEG
entries.goal: Make degradation classification relative per CCTV and keep expensive processing sparse.
issues: Human robustness labels were overwhelmingly OCCUPIED
entries.decision: Redesign robustness sampling in v16.

entries.title: Balanced robustness GT + transition-time SEG
entries.goal: Measure both false-empty and false-occupied behavior and only schedule expensive segmentation near meaningful transitions.
results: SAFE_BASELINE still protected; robustness evaluation became more complete.
issues: UNKNOWN label persistence and state-search CSV collision bugs
entries.decision: Stability fixes in v16.1.

entries.title: O/E/U + state-search stability patch
entries.goal: Make human GT labeling and experiment tables robust.
results: Labeling/state-search crashes repaired without changing detector/evidence cache signatures.
issues: Shared learned-template metadata could still be missing after cache reuse
entries.decision: Repair learned metadata/evidence cache in v16.2.

entries.title: Evidence-cache repair + non-regression audit
entries.goal: Prevent corrupt appearance evidence while preserving the known safe result.
results: Five TEST errors collapsed into two transition events
issues: Tracker ID switch can reset motion history and make a maneuvering vehicle look stationary
Supplemental balance-review images were not packaged in one run
entries.decision: Keep v16.2 algorithm as SAFE_BASELINE; move development workflow into an Agent app.

entries.title: Parking Research Agent + GitHub Auto Update
entries.goal: Turn the research scripts into a versioned local research Agent without changing the v16.2 SAFE_BASELINE algorithm.
results: Algorithm baseline intentionally unchanged from v16.2.
issues: Slot-level motion memory remains a next experiment, not silently merged into this infrastructure release.
entries.decision: Use this as the new development shell for v16.3+ experiments.

entries.title: Track-switch entry hold + weak-owner ghost release
entries.goal: Target the two remaining transition-error families without modifying the v16.2 SAFE_BASELINE.
changes: ENTRY_TRACK_SWITCH_HOLD preserves recent slot-level motion across tracker-ID switches
New tracks that suddenly appear stationary after large motion cannot immediately create OCCUPIED
LEAVING_WEAK_OWNER_RELEASE acts only on baseline LEAVING transitions with weak owner confidence and duplicate-camera EMPTY disagreement
Reacquisition settle interval prevents immediate ghost re-entry
Candidate runs are auditable and never auto-promote the SAFE_BASELINE
results: Four of five previous TEST errors removed
issues: Rules were developed after analyzing errors on the same retained validation video
Independent-video validation is required before SAFE_BASELINE promotion
One TEST over-count event at 17:00 remains
entries.decision: Release as CANDIDATE only; keep v16.2 as SAFE_BASELINE until independent validation.
